top_signals.title: U.S. Senate passes stopgap spending bill without Trump priorities
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Senate approved a short-term spending bill intended to prevent a government shutdown before November’s midterm elections, leaving out President Donald Trump’s requests for Iran war funding and new voter identification measures, Bloomberg reported.
